limits: Bash1.14.7 and Zsh2.3.1/3.0.8 use the documented source adaptations from prior evidence; this is not an unmodified historical OS image.
Zsh generated outputs delegate to /bin/bash where installed, otherwise /bin/sh; both normal and explicit no-Bash fixture paths are tested.
fish delegates the same generated portable collector to /bin/sh; it does not duplicate collectors in fish syntax.
fish4 was executed with --no-config because its Debian binary hardcodes /usr/share/fish for assets, which are only extracted in scratch. This is an isolated interpreter test, not host installation.
fish2 uses matching extracted libncurses5/libtinfo5 through a process-local LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
UTF8 borders are verified as codepoints with unit-cell line lengths; arbitrary terminal font shaping and every locale are outside this matrix.
Collector observations are OS-specific. The host live probe cannot establish BSD/macOS/Windows metric correctness.
integration_comparison_note: Canonical templates were used for execution; a separate fresh Python import subsequently verified their byte equality with the three embedded Unix templates.

fish_startup_evidence.scope: Actual interactive PTY and redirected-output checks. Noninteractive/login/nonlogin/hushlogin, local/SSH filters including empty SSH_CONNECTION/SSH_TTY, duplicate-source suppression and quoted paths. No HOME override or real startup files; hushlogin path is a temporary fixture.

release_status: Verified for the exact recorded source and generated-artifact hashes; this is not an all-platform certification.
fixture_mutation: The Zsh fallback fixture changes only the launcher test if [ -x /bin/bash ] to if false; its generated metadata digest is consequently no longer valid. This explicit dispatch fixture does not represent an unmodified artifact or an original no-Bash OS image.
